name: First Intercept
brief: Identify the alphabet and match exactly the four codebook tokens. Decode the distress call.

name: Corrupted Transmission
brief: The last token has its symbols reversed. Trace the rejection and repair the token to recover the four-letter call sign.

name: Missing Automaton
brief: Rebuild the recognizer for all binary words ending in 1. Add an accepting state and wire the two symbols.

name: Counterexample Hunt
brief: This machine accepts words ending in 1. Find the shortest disagreement, then repair it to accept exactly words ending in 01.

name: Cipher Wheel Mystery
brief: Set the three wheels to the logbook positions (2, 1, 9). Follow the XOR output bits to recover the instruction.
